title: The 6 best vibe coding tools in 2026
summary: I kept about 15 browser tabs open to vibe code all kinds of stuff. Based on all my testing, here are the vibe coding apps that'll make you feel superpowered.
body_markdown:

Lovable


Ease of use


Smooth end-to-end app generation with explanations at each step


Free plan with 30 monthly credits (5/day max); paid plans from $25/month


Bolt


Flexibility and speed


Integrates with Stripe, Figma, Supabase, and GitHub; has a command terminal


Free plan includes 1M tokens/month (300k/day); paid plans from $25/month


v0


Clear view of the building process


Shows detailed feature breakdowns and implementation code (e.g., SQL)


Free plan includes $5 credit usage; paid plans from $30/month


Replit


Building for multiple platforms


AI agent plans app structure before building; deep database controls


Free plan with a limited pool of free credits; paid plans from $20/month


Rocket ****


Vibing and app-based business


Built-in Stripe billing, authentication, and multi-tenant support by default


Free plan with 20 credits; paid plans from $25/month


Dyad


An open-source option for power users


Desktop-based and fully local


Free open-source (bring-your-own AI API key); paid plans from $20/month
